acceptanceCriteria: Prepare a separately reviewable candidate specification for the Chinese twelve-lü content and the Indian śruti content. Each proposal identifies the exact variant, tradition/context, content classification, authoritative sources, ordered pitch data and units, spelling/labels, tonic and reference assumptions, playback mapping, limitations, and disputed interpretations.

Distinguish tuning systems, pitch-reference models, scales/modes, and instrument or performance profiles where applicable; never present a variable or contested tradition as one universal correct tuning.

Present the exact source-qualified candidates and their limits to the user for approval before accepting either candidate as built-in catalog content. Implement only the candidates the user approves, using documented-model or editable-template labeling as appropriate.

For the approved Chinese model, provide a built-in Twelve Lü Pitch-Pipe Reference profile using all twelve model degrees, with explicit configurable Huangzhong reference behavior and source/limitation metadata; do not assert unsupported universal tuning for a performance instrument.

For every approved candidate, demonstrate provenance and classification in catalog metadata, deterministic profile-to-frequency resolution with explicit reference assumptions, and tests for the approved data and silent selection/playback behavior.

testSteps: For each content family, identify primary or authoritative sources and map each material claim/data value to evidence; distinguish source statements from interpretation.

Create a separate candidate dossier recording exact variant/context, classification, supported ordered data and units, labels, reference assumptions, playback mapping, source limits, variability, and disputes; state explicitly when evidence does not support a fixed candidate.
Present each exact dossier to the user and record approval, rejection, or deferral before any catalog inclusion; implement only individually approved candidates.

For approved candidates, verify classification and provenance metadata, ordered pitch identity, reference handling, deterministic model-to-renderer frequency resolution, and shared iPhone/Watch model parity.
Run focused automated data/model and persistence checks; confirm browsing and selection remain silent. Report build, simulator, and physical-device qualification separately and truthfully.
